# Clavis Encrypt 3.16.1

## Ready for Pro and Premium

- Clavis can now activate the Clavis Pro and Clavis Premium license keys from our new online store (Settings → License → Enter license key). Sales open on https://clavisenc.com/pricing.html soon; update now so your copy is ready.
- A key works on up to 2 PCs. To move it, choose Remove license on the old PC first; if that PC is offline, Clavis frees the slot the next time it's online.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download it from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
